title: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee Terms for Items Not as Described
content:
Under the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee of Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee, a buyer whose items arrived not as described may file a guarantee claim with the claim reason not as described on the item line concerned. The claim records the order, the item line, the units it covers and the amount claimed, dated the day it is filed, and then waits for the seller's response period and Northgate's decision; filing it refunds nothing.

**Card-dispute exclusion for these claims.** For a not-as-described claim on an order paid with an external card, and only for such a claim, no Northgate Card dispute can stand on the order's charge, so the card-dispute exclusion is met by the order's own payment record; a return-not-refunded claim on such an order follows its own policy, and every other claim, including any claim on an order paid with a Northgate Card, is still not accepted while the buyer has a card dispute on the same order.

**When the figure is fixed.** Where the order carries exactly one not-received claim whose claim record shows no decision, the amount claimed for an item not as described is fixed only after that claim, if its seller response period has run out, the seller has not refunded every one of its claimed units and its claimed line carries no return request, carries a decision on its claim record; where that claim is referred to a human representative under its own policy, the filing is referred too and nothing is filed. The amount claimed for an item not as described is not fixed until Northgate has settled the restocking top-up on the return request most recently answered on the order with a return authorization.

**Nothing to claim.** Where the amount claimed for an item not as described comes to zero there is nothing to claim and no claim is filed.

**Filing.** The buyer files this claim in person: the agent unlocks the customer's own tool `file_item_condition_claim_763dfc78` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it. One run records the buyer's confirmed guarantee-claim request on the order and opens the claim with the claim reason `not_as_described`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning and format |
|---|---|
| `market_order_id` | the reference number of the Northgate Marketplace order the claim is filed on, read from the buyer's marketplace order lookup (text) |
| `line_event_id` | the reference number of the item line of that same order the claim concerns, read from the order history lookup (text) |
| `units` | the number of units of that line the claim covers, a whole number of at least 1 |
| `amount_claimed_usd` | the amount claimed in US dollars, a positive number with exactly two decimal places, rounded half up to the cent before it is passed |

**Receipt.** On success: "Guarantee claim <claim_reference> filed on <market_order_id> (request <request_reference>): not_as_described, line <line_event_id>, <units> unit(s), USD <amount>." The claim reference is the sign that the claim is on record, and the buyer sees it on the order straight away. Errors are returned when the order is not found, when the line is not an item line of that order, when the units are not a whole number of at least 1, or when the amount is not positive with exactly two decimal places.
